extraInstructions: IMPORTANT: Do NOT use speechManager.speak() anywhere in the game. Only use audioManager.play() for sound effects. Valid sound effects: pickup, drop-correct, drop-wrong, tap, success, error, celebration, hint. The game must teach: (1) Food categories — cereals (rice, wheat), dals (lentils, chana), fruits (apple, banana), vegetables (carrot, tomato), milk and milk products. (2) Food functions — energy-giving foods (rice, roti, potato), body-building foods (dal, milk, egg), protective foods (fruits and vegetables for immunity). (3) Healthy vs junk food — healthy foods give us nutrients and energy, junk foods (burger, chips, cola, candy) have too much sugar, salt and oil and can make us sick. Misconceptions: 'rice is a dal' (rice is a cereal, dals are lentils), 'apple is a vegetable' (apple is a fruit), 'junk food is healthy because it tastes good' (taste does not mean healthy), 'milk is only for babies' (milk gives calcium for all ages). Default width=720, height=560. Use named export (export function FoodGroupsGame), NOT export default. Export interface FoodGroupsGameProps with width?, height?, onComplete?: (score: number) => void.
